# External bibliography and catalogue research, batch 2 — 2026-10-02

Finite task: distinguish Adzom manifestations; inspect four unindexed rKTs handlists; inspect four British Library catalogue records; record primary bibliography for Gangtey and Nepal leads. Completed: 10/10 HTML sources acquired (one retry); 4/4 handlists checked; 3 scholarly PDFs text-extracted as bibliographic research. No tantra scans transcribed, proofread, or collated. PDFs were consulted in temporary storage, not republished here.

## Adzom: two different manifestations

- **Sanje Dorje, New Delhi, 1973–1977, 3 volumes**: Khenpo Yeshi, “The Origins of the Dzogchen Eleven Words and Meanings,” *Journal of Tibetan Literature* 2.2 (2023), 39–82, DOI [10.58371/jtl.2023.69](https://doi.org/10.58371/jtl.2023.69), bibliography explicitly cites **Mu tig rin po che’i phreng ba’i rgyud, 2:417–537, W1KG892**. Saved page `jtl-69.html`. Reproduced from Adzom blockprints held by Dudjom Rinpoche according to the bibliography in *RET* 65 (2023), p.181. The common 417–537 web-transcription pagination matches this manifestation; this observation does not prove electronic provenance or independence.
- **Adzom Chögar, Palyul, 2000, 4 volumes, W1KG11703**: The article “The Chapter on the Theory of the Elements in Klong chen pa’s Theg mchog mdzod” (*RET* 75, 2025), bibliography entry Anonymous 2000a, cites **volume 3, pp.308–427**. [Article PDF](https://d1i1jdw69xsqx0.cloudfront.net/digitalhimalaya/collections/journals/ret/pdf/ret_75_12.pdf). A separate institutional thesis bibliography gives the 4-volume manifestation and BDRC ID [Matteo De Micheli, RYI, 2022](https://ryi.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/Matteo-De-Micheli-TTIP-2022.pdf). rKTs gives item-local folios 1b1–61a5 (see previous batch). These publication pages, item-local folios, and scan image numbers must remain separate fields.
- Physical printing lineage between the two Adzom manifestations is not established. They are separate manifestations, not yet two proven independent witnesses.

## Gangtey, including an additional root location

Cantwell, Mayer, Kowalewski and Achard, “The sGang steng-b rNying ma’i rGyud ’bum Manuscript from Bhutan,” *RET* 11 (2006), catalogue **no.295, p.51**: root in **volume 12 (Na), folios139b–180a**, old digital/page reference **094–119**. Title: Mu tig rin po che ’phreng ba’i rgyud ces bya ba. [Journal PDF](https://d1i1jdw69xsqx0.cloudfront.net/digitalhimalaya/collections/journals/ret/pdf/ret_11.pdf).

This location differs from rKTs Ggt12.6, folios137a8–174a7. Keep a separate bibliographic record pending inspection. Do not automatically equate publication siglum “b” with current EAP “B”: the 2006 introduction alternates a/b terminology; Almogi 2016 p.32 explicitly critiques this confusing nomenclature and recommends plain/illuminated instead.

The British Library records confirm two Gangtey sets, **EAP039/1/3/1** and **EAP039/1/3/2**, of 46 volumes, with dates in the combined range c1640–c1735. Their record repeats the combined series description, so it does not assign each date to a particular manuscript. Both state research access and reproduction only with Gangtey Monastery written permission. Preserve metadata/citations; do not publicly republish scans under an assumed open license.

- [Gangtey A](https://searcharchives.bl.uk/catalog/037-003384930)
- [Gangtey B](https://searcharchives.bl.uk/catalog/037-003384977)
- [Tshamdrak original manuscript](https://searcharchives.bl.uk/catalog/036-002360807): EAP310/4/1; 46 tantra volumes plus catalogue/history volume. Volume12 is Na. This is an original-manuscript scan lead to compare with the 1982 facsimile, not automatically a new independent physical witness.

## Four handlists: outcomes and uncertainty

- **Spiti, Orgyan Dorji, Sumra H.P., 1977, 2 volumes, W21520/Gcd**. [CiNii BA04015320](https://ci.nii.ac.jp/ncid/BA04015320), LCCN78906111, describes a reproduction of a Spiti manuscript and lists nine named tantras, none String of Pearls. The [rKTs handlist](https://www.rkts.org/handlist.php?id=Gcd3) lists16 pieces:12 named and4 unnamed. Unnamed Gcd2.8 (1b1–7b3), Gcd2.9 (1b1–15b5), Gcd2.11 (1b1–4a3), Gcd2.12 (1b1–77a6) still require identification. **No confirmed root entry**, but this is not proof of absence from the whole publication.
- **Drametse, EAP105/1/1, Ggm**. [Handlist](https://www.rkts.org/handlist.php?id=Ggm3) includes all46 volume numbers but no “mu tig” title or G60. The relevant volumes11–12 contain other Seventeen Tantras, and Ggm12.2 is unidentified (1b1–11a7). Treat as **unresolved, no root confirmed**; do not create a false positive from collection membership.
- **Sangye Ling, W1KG16449, Gsg**. [Handlist](https://www.rkts.org/handlist.php?id=Gsg3) does not include volumes11–12 and currently covers volume numbers1–10,13–18. No root hit is inconclusive because the relevant corpus section is not listed.
- **Tingkye supplement W25815, Gkk**. [Handlist](https://www.rkts.org/handlist.php?id=Gkk3) gives volumes1–5; no root-title hit. Unresolved rather than counted as another witness.

## Nepal and further Bhutan leads

Orna Almogi, “The rNying ma rgyud ’bum Set at the National Archives Kathmandu: The History of Its Production and Transmission,” in *Tibetan Manuscript and Xylograph Traditions*, Hamburg2016, pp.31–66; bibliography pp.61–63 [publisher-distributor PDF](https://www.bibliaimpex.com/books/pdfs/9783945151037.pdf):

- **Kathmandu**: illuminated set,35 surviving volumes of a presumed37; National Archives Kathmandu manuscript5; NGMPP microfilm **AT1/1–AT25**,1989. Root location not established.
- **Nubri**: illuminated37-volume set, Slob dpon ’Gyur med, Samagaon; origin Brag dkar rta so; NGMPP **L426/4–L448/1**,1993. Root location not established. Distinct from rKTs Gns/MW1ER27.
- **Dongkarla**:28 volumes; monastery in Paro;2012 Hamburg/PBWH digitisation. Root location not established.
- **Spa-sgar**:46 volumes;2012 Hamburg/PBWH digitisation; manuscript subsequently destroyed by fire (29 February2012). Root location not established.

Almogi’s precise manuscript and reel identifiers supersede vaguer secondary claims that conflate the two Nepal sets. No manuscript scans were acquired from these leads.

## False positives / unresolved near-title

[British Library EAP039/1/4/165](https://searcharchives.bl.uk/catalog/040-003385189) is **Phyag len rin po che mu tig phreng ba**,188TIFF images, Gangtey Rinpoche’s private library. The record supplies no author or text-level description. Its title differs from the root. Classify as **unresolved near-title, excluded from root witness count pending identification**, not proven unrelated. It carries the same research-only/no-reproduction-without-permission conditions.

Exclude the similarly titled **Gser gyi me tog ... sgron ma ’bar ba’i rgyud don gsal bar byed pa mu tig phreng ba brgyus pa**: it is a commentary on *Blazing Lamp*, not this root tantra (documented *RET*65 p.165 fn.48). Other irrelevant hits include Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö’s advice “zhal gdams mu tig phreng ba,” Niguma’s “rje btsun mu tig phreng ba,” the medical “gso dpyad mu tig ’phreng ba,” and Ratnākaraśānti’s Hevajra commentary.

## Search outcomes and acquisition limits

- Queries included exact Wylie and variants; Spiti1977; Adzom1973/2000; Nubri; Kathmandu; Mustang; rKTs; EAP.
- Exact-title + Mustang returned no verified target-specific result. This is a search outcome, not evidence the region has no copy.
- EAP web front-end returned inaccessible/JavaScript challenge pages. No challenge bypass was attempted. British Library archival catalogue works normally.
- Cambridge Digital Himalaya PDF endpoints timed out; the publisher archive’s CloudFront mirror returned RET11 and RET65 successfully.
- Taipei1991 volume56 is cited for the root in Daniel Scheidegger’s “Lamps in the Leap Over,” *RET*14 (2008), p.63. Root pagination and exact source-facsimile mapping remain unresolved. Existing NGB literature states the Taipei collection reprints other editions; do not count it independent without source verification.

Next finite task: verify the RET75/12 author and precise publication year; resolve Taipei volume56/root pagination; search NGMPP title catalogue for Nepal root coordinates. Those are bibliographic tasks only; no translation phase started.
